_doc: No-R1 factorial (5 spike controls x 4 settling mechanisms) on gs2_c03_lr2_d05 = k3p_simple + reg_coeff .3, lr .0085, d_lr_mult .5 (constant LR, AMSGrad (0,.999), no noise, no EMA anchor, no direct response, guard + A2 on). Every arm removes R1 on reals; every arm's spike guard reads max_exp_avg_sq (the AMSGrad buffer the update uses; the gs2 reference read exp_avg_sq). Generated by gen_arms.py.

nr_none_none.formulation: gs2_c03_lr2_d05 with R1 on reals removed. spike: none: R1 removed, nothing added on the real side (control). settle: none: nothing replaces R1's settling role. Fake one-sided RMS cap kept; all terms (reg_coeff/2)-scaled.

nr_none_hinge.formulation: gs2_c03_lr2_d05 with R1 on reals removed. spike: none: R1 removed, nothing added on the real side (control). settle: hinge: critic loss = relativistic hinge mean relu(1 - (D(r) - D(f))); generator keeps RpGAN softplus. Fake one-sided RMS cap kept; all terms (reg_coeff/2)-scaled.

nr_none_oadam.formulation: gs2_c03_lr2_d05 with R1 on reals removed. spike: none: R1 removed, nothing added on the real side (control). settle: oadam: critic update = lib/oadam.py OptimisticAdam(amsgrad=True), betas (0,.999), base critic LR. Fake one-sided RMS cap kept; all terms (reg_coeff/2)-scaled.

nr_none_anchor.formulation: gs2_c03_lr2_d05 with R1 on reals removed. spike: none: R1 removed, nothing added on the real side (control). settle: anchor: K3P EMA-critic anchor prox term forced on at constant LR (stock reg_anchor_weight 1, decay .999). Fake one-sided RMS cap kept; all terms (reg_coeff/2)-scaled.
